data.title: [Incident (Recovered)] Partial Cloud Service Disruption in Korea (Seoul) Zone B

eventUpdates.content: At 06:25, all affected cloud services have been fully restored to normal operation.

At 05:38, following power restoration in the data center, network equipment has been prioritized for recovery and is now operational. Affected cloud services are currently undergoing phased restoration.

At 03:56 (UTC+8) on April 22, 2026, the data center cooling system has been progressively restored to operation, and ambient temperatures are returning to normal levels. Alibaba Cloud engineers will maintain continuous monitoring of equipment status and proceed with subsequent recovery activities.

22:25 Alibaba Cloud engineers have executed shutdown protection operations on the affected cloud products in accordance with the emergency response plan. The cooling system anomaly is currently being urgently handled by Alibaba Cloud engineers. We will keep you updated with any latest developments.

Dear Customer,

At 20:06 (Beijing Time) on April 21, 2026, Alibaba Cloud CloudMonitor detected an anomaly in the cooling system of a data center suite in Korea Zone B. Our engineers have initiated the emergency response pre-plan and are performing migration and shutdown operations on affected cloud products. During this process, some cloud services may experience disruptions. Please closely monitor your business recovery status. Should you have any questions or require assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Alibaba Cloud
